title: The Planet Where Pants Are Illegal
sources: Original fiction (SCIFI world-rule). Real idea used loosely: many insects, including moths, seek dark, sheltered, folded spots to rest and nest (Smithsonian / Natural History Museum notes on moth roosting behaviour).

lines.text: On this planet, wearing pants is against the law,
and nobody will tell the settlers why.
Mia landed on Tuesday, in her favourite jeans.
The locals stared at her legs.
Every single one.
A kid gasped, she's wearing pants!
The mayor ran over, sweating.
Take them off, he begged, right now!
But Mia checked the rulebook.
Page one, line one: no pants.
She laughed. Who bans pants?
So she wore them to the picnic anyway.
And that wasn't the strange part.
At noon, the whole sky started humming.
Then something glowed in the grass.
Then ten somethings. Then a thousand.
They were all flying straight at her legs.
She ran, but a glowing cloud followed every step.
The mayor covered his eyes.
By sunset, her jeans were buzzing, glowing, and completely full.
See, glow-moths love nesting in dark, folded cloth,
and her jeans held a million of them.
The moths wouldn't leave for a whole week.
So the very first law was, shorts only.
Which is why, on this planet,
